gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: We've ___ out of milk — could you get some more?
The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
